note: Claude's own votes, written before Gemini's and ChatGPT's answers were seen (GitHub was refusing to start runs when this was written, so the question could not go out yet). L2 reworded and Q4 added on Nov 23, 5:45 p.m. ET, still before their answers.
L1: AGREE. The Ledger had seven separate race menus, one per list, and no chart at all outside the report card. One picker at the top is easier: 'All races' leaves the page as it was, and a race shows that race's numbers, chart and holdings and lines every list up. It must stay a view of the same parts the race pages use, so no number is worked out a second way.
L2: AGREE. The crown alone says who is first but not by how much. Each amount is the same sum as that AI's own chart headline, so a button never disagrees with its chart. My first version used the Race standings figure, which was C$43 off the headline for Gemini in Play it safe on Nov 23 after exchange rates moved; my mistake, fixed that evening.
L3: AGREE, with the wording rule: 'View who's winning' while the race is on, 'View who finished first' from the finish, and never 'winner' or 'won' before the final scoring is recorded (the rule all three of us agreed for the finish).
L4: AGREE. On every computer the last three columns (profit, return, the reason) were off-screen behind a sideways scroll bar, and each row was as tall as the hidden reason. The reason on its own full-width line is easier to read than a 240 px column. Same cells, same order, same words.
L5: AGREE. The owner's own picture of the China page shows the 'Why' column cut off. Wrapping the small lines under a profit is enough to make it fit.
L6: AGREE. A menu is the compact choice on a phone (the Ledger's other race pickers are menus too), and it follows the site rule that every menu is in A to Z order.
Q1: KEEP as it is for now: a race card still opens that race's page. Changing what a tap does a week before the finish is not worth the surprise; the new bar already picks the race in place.
Q2: LATER. The High risk page already has its own charts and part switch. If the owner wants the same picker on the High risk ledger it is a small follow-up.
Q3: KEEP 'All races' as the opening view (the owner's earlier choice: lists always start on all races). Do not remember the pick between visits.
Q4: KEEP both for now and add a short note. Race standings is the runner's own figure at the last check-in and decides who is shown first; changing how it is worked out five days before the finish is a bigger step than a note, and the owner should decide it.
